scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:go
scripts.lint:go: test -z "$(find cmd internal -name '*.go' -print | xargs gofumpt -l)" && go vet ./... && staticcheck ./... && golangci-lint run ./...
scripts.test: bun run test:ts && bun run test:go
scripts.gate: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
